name: groundcore-nine
features: Spacer tab calculates row spacing from row configuration, with an optional plant pick that auto fills spacing.
Plants tab looks up a plant profile and sends it to the spacer with use in spacer.
Browse tab filters plants by category.
Sandbox tab places, moves and deletes rows, structures and drives on a map, with zoom and pan.
Show map and use my GPS put the layout on a real map.
